title: Ottoman Plovdiv: quarters in the tax registers 1472–1614 and dated buildings (G. Boykov, Austrian Academy of Sciences / Zenodo)
describe: The quarters (mahalles) of Ottoman Plovdiv in each tax register that counts households there (1472, 1489, 1516, 1525, 1530, 1570, 1596, 1614), with the households and the author's population estimate; and its mosques, churches, synagogue, baths, khans and schools with the century the author dates them to.

dating.label: quarter counted in the Ottoman tax register of {year}

datingLabel: the century the author dates the building to
